content.text: Welcome to the Castle!
Did you come here to become|a Dynamon Captain?
Let's start by testing your SKILLS!
NICE! you have great potential.|Now choose your own Dynamon!
Great choice, you will make a great team!
Now, I have something to give you...
These ITEMS will be useful in your journey.
Speaking of which,|let's find a WILD DYNAMON...
Let's find some wild|Dynamons to BATTLE!
WAIT! Now that it's weak, let's|try to CATCH it!
WOW! Your Dynamon can LEVEL UP!
We use SHARDS to do that.|Use some now!
You can SWITCH Dynamons during battle.
Let's use the Hermatude you just caught!
That's Sofia, she is a trainer like you...
Go and BATTLE her!
During battles, you can use one ITEM per turn.
Use the SKILL CAN you just got!
Dynamons and Skills have TYPES...
Use the STRONG type when possible!
You got access to a new location.
Let's go there!
Hi! My name is Julian...
Let's practice our battle technique!
Maybe I'm too old for this...
Great adventure ahead, | stay safe, my dear.
WOW, you're STRONG!|But I'm stronger!
Next time i won't lose!
Hi, my name is Jenni!
There is a rumor about| some cool mission!
Let's find out| who will do better?
You're so COOL!!
I'll try my best to defeat you!
I'm the Fire Elite. And you're that newbie| everyone talks about.
if I were you |I wouldn't go on the mission.
Show me what you've got!
It's not over yet!
Hello, my name is Maxwell.
I'm looking for someone's help.
But let me test you first.
You can definitely handle it!
Something strange is happening in the Treasure Cave.
Could you investigate it for me? I'm a rich | man and can give you a high reward!
I've heard you defeated the Fire Elite!
You have a difficult way ahead. | I'll make sure you're ready.
You're a tough one!
Deeper in the Caves enemies are stronger.
HA HA, we meet again!
This time I won't lose!|The power of my earth Dynamons is undefeatable!
NO! HOW DID YOU DO THAT?
I won't bother you anymore.
Turn back or| I'll teach you a lesson!
You're still too week |to enter the Challenge Cave.
Proof yourself first in the Gold City.
Hi, Beautiful!
Look how far I managed to come!
Who will be better this time?
You've become so much stronger!
I can't keep up with you.
HOW DID YOU GET HERE!
Sorry, I'm just surprised. Let's train!
You got me good. |The Fire Elite is waiting for you.
Klaude was easy on you. I won't be as kind.
I saw a dragon make a huge dragon egg | nest at the Challenge Cave.
So you better turn back!
We will not allow you to take that dragon egg.
Save me from that DRAGON!
My hero! Thank you so much! You seem ready for | the Challenge Cave world. Go try it out!
Stop right there, boy!
This cave belongs to my family!
I won't let you further!
My daughter is going to stop you! I have been |training her for a long time for this battle.
Also she mastered the most rare dynamon kind.
We won't let steal even one egg!
I will stop you and make my father proud!
It was a fair fight, you are stronger than me.
Last chance! Last fight!
Be ready to feel all mighty power| of my electric dynamons!
It's useless, you're too strong! |I give up.
Thank you, my friend! Now, |when all members of the family are defeated | I can take over their Dynamons farm.
I offered them a great price. They just won't listen!
Please, I beg you! Help us defeat | this rich and evil man!
Maxwell has been trying to get his hands | on our farm for a very long time.
I could have made you all rich! | You are all fools!
Thank you, you saved our farm!
Thank you, boy!
You're not as bad for a newbie.
Thank you, friend!
Look! It is hatching!
New life starts . . .
And that is how I remembered the story.
Dom you are getting old!| That is not how the story went!
If you really want to know how the story went. | Please play the Dynamons World game.
You can find it in the google play store and | the Appstore by searching on Dynamons World.
I will tell you what really happened| in my adventure through the 17 worlds.
